decisions.reason: Restricting filler images to pages with huge empty spaces does not change author-name, author-photo identity, source, or placement requirements.
The filler-image placement condition does not change category labels, category mappings, or their placement.
The source selects where supplied filler images may be inserted and does not alter the approved Inter font or its treatment.
The supplied filler images are unrelated to the required size and circular shape of author photos.
The general issue-assembly obligation and Flat Plan reference remain unchanged; the page-specific filler-image condition is owned by the source Requirement.
The filler-image placement decision does not change issue metadata. The independent November issue statement from the same message is already represented in this candidate's history.
The filler-image placement condition does not modify the restriction against using red for the Dorian Vale article.
Adding supplied images only to pages with huge empty spaces does not alter the requirement to finalize the table of contents from final pagination.
The source does not change two-page spread behavior or the even-page-count constraint; shared layout terminology is incidental.
The supplied filler images do not change inclusion or end-matter placement of the tribute page.
The filler-image placement condition does not change which cover-mentioned articles must be included or how their placement is determined.
The source does not modify the requirement for accurate final article page numbers on the cover.
